task: Review, validate and integrate an existing uncommitted hosted preview prototype and host an isolated free-tier sample preview. The prototype was created after an invalid plan; preserve and disclose that process deviation.
nonGoals: Live crawling, production scoring, merchant data, or model calls
Paid Cloudflare resources or modifying any pre-existing Cloudflare configuration or service
Deploying from PR CI, merging the PR, or changing repository protections
Changing existing rubric weights, fixtures, or evaluation gates

outcomes.description: A responsive accessible preview presents URL entry, progress, and a report while making synthetic sample status and the lack of live retrieval unmistakable.
outcomes.evidence: UI smoke checks and independent review

outcomes.description: The sample report follows the scoring and report contract, including plain scores, 40/60 weighting, evidence, assignable prioritized actions, subchecks, and conditional recovery.
outcomes.evidence: Sample data and rubric regression tests

outcomes.description: A new isolated free-tier-only Cloudflare static deployment is prepared and may be deployed only after CI and independent review, separately from PR checks.
outcomes.evidence: Deployment documentation and actual deployment observation

outcomes.description: Existing offline checks remain intact and application lint, typecheck, build, runtime and meaningful regression checks are permanently registered in CI.

process.description: Commit this valid integration plan before further implementation, preserve existing evaluator, fixture and security gates, and disclose the invalid original plan and pre-existing prototype to independent review.
Record actual validation, limitations, decisions and a resumable handoff; perform a genuine fresh-agent continuation at a meaningful boundary.
process.evidence: Evaluation trace, handoff and fresh-agent observation

process.description: Use only a newly created isolated Cloudflare resource within the free tier, and deploy only after hosted CI and independent review.

styleEfficiency.description: Keep the interface concise, approachable, responsive, and evidence-first without implying sample findings assess the entered URL.

exitTest.reason: The hosted preview introduces a new application and deployment handoff requiring genuine fresh-agent continuation.
